nodes.name: When Called by Chat
nodes.notes: Called by the check_availability tool in 'Velure Chat Assistant'.

nodes.name: Availability Webhook
nodes.notes: Public, read-only: GET /webhook/velure-availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns only the taken times for that date (no names or emails). Used by the booking form to grey out taken slots.

nodes.name: Query Bookings
nodes.notes: Notion API query: Status = Confirmed and Slot key starts with one of the planned dates. Uses the same Notion credential as the other Velure workflows.

nodes.name: Tool Result
nodes.notes: Last node of the tool path: its output is what the assistant reads.
